content.intro: This lesson covers Separating Formatting from Data in the PowerShell learning path. It expands the supplied syllabus heading into an actionable draft with a visual, a worked example, and a short knowledge check.
content.why_it_matters: Use command discovery and built-in help before composing a longer command. Inspect returned object types and properties, quote paths containing spaces, and keep destructive operations previewed or confined to disposable practice data. Formatting is for people; select and preserve structured properties before the final display step.
